Name: Amazon Brand - Solimo Essential Engineered Wood Coffee Table (Wenge Finish)

Sturdy structure made of premium quality engineered wood Made from European standard particle board to ensure durability Spacious table top and shelves, for placing magazines, ornaments, etc. Aesthetic, easy-to-clean design with smooth edges diminish chances of scrapes and cuts Rigorously tested for safety and quality, underwent 15+ safety and quality checks Long-lasting table resistant to humidity, stains and hot water Includes a 3-year warranty on manufacturing defects
